cards_removed_check.name: cards_removed_check
cards_removed_check.value: "cards"."removed_at" is not null or ("cards"."removed_by_recycle" is null and "cards"."removed_by_purchase" is null)

pack_openings_source_check.name: pack_openings_source_check
pack_openings_source_check.value: ("pack_openings"."source" = 'shop') = ("pack_openings"."theme_id" is not null) and ("pack_openings"."source" = 'shop') = ("pack_openings"."ledger_entry_id" is not null)

pack_openings_price_check.name: pack_openings_price_check
pack_openings_price_check.value: ("pack_openings"."source" = 'shop') = ("pack_openings"."price" is not null) and ("pack_openings"."price" is null or "pack_openings"."price" > 0)
